story: I spent the day teaching seniors how to use an iPhone
text: Telephones only seem intuitive because we got taught to use them as kids. If you look back, there was a massive effort to teach people to use them. You can still find some of the educational films: [VIDEO]

I think this “awesome”, “amazing”, “super exciting” phase came much later than the moon walking era. Remember it’s been over 50 years since humans walked on the moon. Much has changed. See these old videos, where people talk in a straightforward way: Car transmission [LINK] How to dial your phone [LINK] The dial comes to town [VIDEO] Now go watch that Apple video again and you’ll see what I’m talking about.

story: How RCA Victor sold Sound Service to classrooms in 1939
text: The Bell System did this when dial telephone service was first introduced. They held town meetings with a giant rotary dial onstage where someone explained it and demonstrated how to dial your calls. And they made an instructional film about it! [VIDEO]
